dedupe_keys.name: jrc ghs built r2015b landsat built up grid 1975 2014

description: The European Commission Joint Research Centre publishes this historical Global Human Settlement Layer built-up grid from Landsat imagery. Its four epochs represent 1975, 1990, 2000 and 2014, with classes for built-up presence. The production grid is about 38 m in Spherical Mercator; the provider also describes 250 m and 1 km versions in Mollweide projection. Global TIFF rasters are offered through the JRC dataset page in compressed packages. Settlement and infrastructure exposure simulations can overlay older roads, buildings or population estimates with these epoch maps, or reproduce analyses written against the 2015 release. The page labels R2015B obsolete and points to newer GHSL products. This older version does not necessarily match current classes or processing methods. The page states anonymous access without registration and the European Commission reuse notice: reuse is allowed with source acknowledgement, subject to individual third-party rights. No charge is stated, and no raster was downloaded to inspect cell codes. This archived grid complements the catalogue's later R2023A GHSL built-up and population record by preserving four historical epochs processed with the 2015 method.
name: JRC GHS-BUILT R2015B Landsat built-up grid, 1975–2014
notes: G3 G3-0658. Draft only. No resource files downloaded or software executed. The JRC page marks this release OBSOLETE and names DOI 10.2905/JRC.KJFTQMR. It gives European Commission reuse terms rather than a Creative Commons licence. The current catalogue's GHSL record covers R2023A, not this explicitly versioned R2015B product.
